final: WITH per_tel AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY telescref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS overall_avg FROM per_tel) SELECT p.telescref, p.avg_mod AS avg_modindex, p.avg_mod - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall, p.avg_mod / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_overall FROM per_tel p, overall o WHERE p.avg_mod > o.overall_avg ORDER BY ratio_to_overall DESC LIMIT 10
